podcast.body: Featured on their 1980 album *Zenyatta Mondatta*, this song is highlighted for the "magic" interplay between Sting on bass and Stewart Copeland on drums, demonstrating amazing playing from everyone. "Listen for the interplay between Sting and steward Copeland. This is magic."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song is cited as an example of a track featuring a drum kit recorded using the "Close Miking" technique, which was popular in the 1950s, 60s, and most of the 70s. This technique aimed to capture the pure sound of the stick striking the drum, resulting in a tight, sharp crack from the snare. "The police and driven to tears, that was a close mic drum kit."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
